description: Ideas of scientists who died in 1900-2026 (found by the scouts Grok and Gemini in Wikipedia death lists in many languages), each crystallised into a rule an AI agent can apply, grouped by agent blind spot: stale_data, one_model, rumour_vs_fact, measurement_error, answer_cost, side_effects (the agent does not see how others respond or what side effects follow), look_alike (similar taken for the same: duplicates with typos, one word for different things), own_limits (fluent answers where it cannot really answer). Each card has the core idea, the rule (Orb Studio's interpretation), the Wikipedia link and, where it exists, a live Orb Studio sensor that checks the rule now. Filter by blind_spot or search with query.
name: get_crystals
title: Crystal Library: reasoning rules from the ideas of scientists who died in 1900-2026
